name: session-state
description: Keeps short notes of what you asked and decided in a long chat, in a session.md the agent can read, with a side panel.

openrouterKey.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouterKey.description: Used for the Jev gate. Leave empty to use the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable. Default: empty.

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: jev: ask Jev (OpenRouter) first; off: Haiku reads every turn and nothing leaves Claude Code. Default: jev.

threshold.title: Gate threshold
threshold.description: A turn goes to Haiku when Jev's probability is at least this. 0.7 keeps about 94% of saved notes on target and finds about half of the important turns; lower is noisier, higher misses more. Default: 0.7.

jevModel.title: Jev model
jevModel.description: OpenRouter decision model id, e.g. jev-1.13 or jev-1.14. Default: jev-1.13 (the one the threshold was calibrated on). Empty means the default.

haikuModel.title: Extractor model
haikuModel.description: The Claude model that writes the notes, run on your Claude Code login. Default: claude-haiku-5-5. Empty means the default.

effort.title: Extractor effort
effort.description: How hard the extractor thinks. Default: high.

maxWords.title: Words per note
maxWords.description: Longest allowed note. Default: 15. Empty means the default.

auditRate.title: Audit rate
auditRate.description: Share of turns the gate skips that Haiku reads anyway, to measure what the gate misses. 0 turns it off. Default: 0. Empty means the default.

openPanelOnStart.title: Open the panel at session start
openPanelOnStart.description: Open the notes panel when a session starts. Default: off.
